verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਅਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes adhes kar pairee pai raharaas kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Considering the sermon of the Guru as the order they observe the code being humble.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਧਰਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਣੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਲਕ ਸੁਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: charan saran masatak dharan charan ren mukh tilak suha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: They surrender at the feet of Guru and apply he dust of his-feet to their heads.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਦਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਅਲੇਖ ਵਿਸੇਖ ਬਣੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: bharam karam dhaa lekh meT lekh alekh visekh bana(n)dhe|

en.bdb: By effacing the delusive writings of destiny, they create special love for imperceptible God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ ਨ ਲਖ ਪੁਜੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: jagamag jot udhot kar sooraj cha(n)dh na lakh puja(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Myriads of suns and moons cannot reach their effulgence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: haumai garab nivaar kai saadhasa(n)gat sach mel mila(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Deleting ego from themselves they take dip into the sacred tank of the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਚੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat pooran braham charan kamal poojaa paracha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Holy congregation is the abode of the perfect Brahm and they (gurmukhs) keep their mind imbued with the lotus feet (of Lord).
They become the bumblebee and reside in the pleasure-petals (of the holy Lord).
